notes: 빨간 암탉 녹음 대본(2026-10-31 코드와 함께 작성). voices 는 녹음 전에 정한다(PLAN §목소리 배정 제안: nar 차분한 여성 이야기꾼, hen 씩씩한 엄마, chick 높은 아이 목소리, cat 나른한 젊은 여성, dog 장난스러운 젊은 남성, pig 느리고 굵은 남성). ElevenLabs 만. 합창(chorus3 = 고양이·개·돼지 "난 싫어!", chorus = 다섯 배역)은 extra 에 배역마다 따로 녹음해 mix_chorus_el.py(witch_candy 방식)로 겹친 뒤 chorus 의 문장 키로 NARRATION_CLIPS 에 넣는다. 낱말 클립(W_*)은 내레이터 목소리, 영어는 앱에서 0.9배. 영어 낱말은 받아쓰기(mlx_whisper)로 반복·발음 검사.

lines.text: 농장에 빨간 암탉이 살았어요. 병아리 셋이랑요.
lines.en: On a farm lived a little red hen, with her three chicks.
segs: On a farm lived a little red hen, with her three chicks.

lines.text: 어느 날, 암탉이 밀 씨앗을 찾았어요.
lines.en: One day, the hen found some wheat seeds.
segs: One day, the hen found some wheat seeds.

lines.text: 이 씨앗을 심으면 밀이 자라. 누가 심어 줄래?
lines.en: If we plant these seeds, wheat will grow. Who will help me plant them?
segs: If we plant these seeds, wheat will grow. Who will help me plant them?

lines.en: Not I! I want a nap!
segs: Not I! I want a nap!

lines.text: 암탉은 어떤 마음일까요? 시무룩한 얼굴을 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: How does the hen feel? Tap the sad face.
segs: How does the hen feel? Tap the sad face.

lines.en: This is not a smiling time.
segs: This is not a smiling time.

lines.text: 암탉은 조금 시무룩했어요. 하지만 금방 기운을 냈지요.
lines.en: The hen felt a little sad. But soon she cheered up.
segs: The hen felt a little sad. But soon she cheered up.

lines.en: Then I will do it myself!
segs: Then I will do it myself!

lines.text: 암탉은 씨앗을 심고 물을 주었어요. 쪼르르.
lines.en: The hen planted the seeds and gave them water. Trickle, trickle.
segs: The hen planted the seeds and gave them water. Trickle, trickle.

lines.text: 해가 뜨고 지고, 또 뜨고… 밀이 쑥쑥 자랐어요!
lines.en: The sun rose and set, and rose again… and the wheat grew tall!
segs: The sun rose and set, and rose again… and the wheat grew tall!

lines.en: The wheat is golden and ripe.
segs: The wheat is golden and ripe.

lines.text: 밀이 다 익었어. 누가 베어 줄래?
lines.en: The wheat is ripe. Who will help me cut it?
segs: The wheat is ripe. Who will help me cut it?

lines.en: Then I will do it myself.
segs: Then I will do it myself.

lines.en: The hen cut the wheat and tied it into a bundle.
segs: The hen cut the wheat and tied it into a bundle.

lines.en: Who will help me take it to the mill?
segs: Who will help me take it to the mill?

lines.en: Then I will go by myself.
segs: Then I will go by myself.

lines.en: Round and round went the windmill, grinding the wheat fine.
segs: Round and round went the windmill, grinding the wheat fine.

lines.en: Who will help me make the bread?
segs: Who will help me make the bread?

lines.text: 그럼 나 혼자 만들게. 얘들아, 도와줄래?
lines.en: Then I will make it myself. Chicks, will you help me?
segs: Then I will make it myself. Chicks, will you help me?

lines.en: Squish, squish. The dough got soft and squishy.
segs: Squish, squish. The dough got soft and squishy.

lines.en: The oven grew warm, and the kitchen glowed.
segs: The oven grew warm, and the kitchen glowed.

lines.text: 빵이 다 구워졌어요! 노릇노릇, 고소한 냄새가 솔솔.
lines.en: The bread is ready! Golden brown, with a yummy smell drifting out.
segs: The bread is ready! Golden brown, with a yummy smell drifting out.

lines.text: 냄새가 마당까지 퍼졌어요. 고양이도, 개도, 돼지도 코를 킁킁.
lines.en: The smell drifted out to the yard. The cat, the dog and the pig went sniff, sniff.
segs: The smell drifted out to the yard. The cat, the dog and the pig went sniff, sniff.

lines.en: Who will help me eat this bread?
segs: Who will help me eat this bread?

lines.text: 아니. 심을 때도, 벨 때도, 만들 때도 너희는 싫다고 했지.
lines.en: No. When I planted, when I cut, and when I baked, you all said, "Not I."
segs: No. When I planted, when I cut, and when I baked, you all said, "Not I."

lines.text: 그러니 이 빵은 나랑 병아리들이 먹을게.
lines.en: So my chicks and I will eat this bread.
segs: So my chicks and I will eat this bread.

lines.text: 암탉과 병아리들은 빵을 냠냠 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: The hen and her chicks ate the bread. Yum, yum!
segs: The hen and her chicks ate the bread. Yum, yum!

lines.text: 친구들은 창밖에서 조용히 바라보았어요. 그제야 알았거든요.
lines.en: Their friends watched quietly through the window. Now they understood.
segs: Their friends watched quietly through the window. Now they understood.

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 암탉이 빵을 또 구웠어요.
lines.en: The next morning, the hen baked bread again.
segs: The next morning, the hen baked bread again.

lines.en: But this time, her friends came running first!
segs: But this time, her friends came running first!

lines.en: Hen, we want to help! I brought a tomato.
segs: Hen, we want to help! I brought a tomato.

lines.en: Hen, we want to help! I brought a strawberry.
segs: Hen, we want to help! I brought a strawberry.

lines.text: 좋아! 그럼 오늘은 다 같이 샌드위치를 만들자.
lines.en: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make sandwiches together.
segs: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make sandwiches together.

lines.text: 좋아! 그럼 오늘은 다 같이 피자를 만들자.
lines.en: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make a pizza together.
segs: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make a pizza together.

lines.text: 좋아! 그럼 오늘은 다 같이 팬케이크를 만들자.
lines.en: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make pancakes together.
segs: Wonderful! Then today, let's all make pancakes together.

lines.en: But how do you make bread?
segs: But how do you make bread?

lines.en: I'll show you, one step at a time, starting with the seeds.
segs: I'll show you, one step at a time, starting with the seeds.

lines.text: 맨 먼저 심는 건 뭘까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: What do we plant first? Tap it.
segs: What do we plant first? Tap it.

lines.text: 씨앗이 자라면? 다음 걸 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: What do the seeds grow into? Tap the next one.
segs: What do the seeds grow into? Tap the next one.

lines.en: What do we get when we grind the wheat? Tap it.
segs: What do we get when we grind the wheat? Tap it.

lines.en: We need seeds before wheat can grow.
segs: We need seeds before wheat can grow.

lines.en: We grind wheat to make flour.
segs: We grind wheat to make flour.

lines.en: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then bread!
segs: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then bread!

lines.text: 씨앗, 밀, 밀가루, 그리고 피자 반죽!
lines.en: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then pizza dough!
segs: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then pizza dough!

lines.en: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then pancakes!
segs: Seeds, wheat, flour, and then pancakes!

lines.text: 빵 위에 하나씩 얹자. 얘들아, 집어 줄래?
lines.en: Let's put things on the bread, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?
segs: Let's put things on the bread, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?

lines.text: 반죽 위에 하나씩 얹자. 얘들아, 집어 줄래?
lines.en: Let's put things on the dough, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?
segs: Let's put things on the dough, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?

lines.text: 팬케이크 위에 하나씩 얹자. 얘들아, 집어 줄래?
lines.en: Let's put things on the pancakes, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?
segs: Let's put things on the pancakes, one at a time. Can you pass them to me?

lines.text: 먼저 반죽을 만들자. 밀가루랑 우유를 넣고…
lines.en: First, let's make the batter. Flour and milk…
segs: First, let's make the batter. Flour and milk…

lines.en: Sizzle, sizzle in the pan. The pancakes are cooked!
segs: Sizzle, sizzle in the pan. The pancakes are cooked!

lines.en: I roll the dough out round and flat…
segs: I roll the dough out round and flat…

lines.en: The egg is from me! I laid it myself.
segs: The egg is from me! I laid it myself.

lines.en: Everyone sat together under the big tree.
segs: Everyone sat together under the big tree.

lines.en: And a cup of milk for everyone!
segs: And a cup of milk for everyone!

lines.en: It tastes even better when we make it together!
segs: It tastes even better when we make it together!

lines.text: 일할 때 같이 하면 먹을 때도 같이 먹어요. 같이 만들면 더 맛있어요.
lines.en: When we work together, we eat together. And food tastes better when we make it together.
segs: When we work together, we eat together. And food tastes better when we make it together.

lines.en: Flour is in the white sack.
segs: Flour is in the white sack.

lines.en: Water is in the blue jug.
segs: Water is in the blue jug.

lines.en: A tomato is red and round.
segs: A tomato is red and round.

lines.en: Corn has lots of yellow kernels.
segs: Corn has lots of yellow kernels.

lines.en: A strawberry is red, with tiny seeds.
segs: A strawberry is red, with tiny seeds.

lines.en: A banana is yellow and long.
segs: A banana is yellow and long.

lines.en: Honey is in the yellow jar.
segs: Honey is in the yellow jar.
